entry.title: NIS 2 Directive: Commission plans an implementing act
entry.summary: The NIS2 Directive sets out obligations on essential and important entities in 18 critical sectors in the EU for the reporting of significant cybersecurity incidents. This act will provide common incident notification templates for notifications under the NIS2 Directive, thereby streamlining the format and the type of information to be notified across all 27 Member States and supporting the Commission’s broader simplification agenda. Formal title: Commission Implementing Regulation further specifying the type of information, the format and the procedure of a notification submitted pursuant to Article 23(1) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555. The Commission adopts it after the opinion of the Member States in the Cybersecurity Committee, under the examination procedure (Art. 5, 6 and 7 of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011). A draft is to be published for feedback on Have your say.

entry.title: EU Space Act: EP committee vote is late against the forecast
entry.summary: The forecast expects it around 14 Apr 2027. It keeps its median of publication only if the step comes by 20 Jul 2026; it has not come since 21 Jul 2026. On 8 Sep 2025, when the procedure reached its current step, the median of publication in the Official Journal was 29 Jul 2027; it held within 14 days only if the step came by 20 Jul 2026. The step is overdue: the median now stands at 7 Jun 2028. If the step came on 29 Oct 2026, the median would be 15 Nov 2027.
